style: A single antique map sheet photographed flat: heavy aged paper, foxing, torn edges, hand-inked coastlines, faded red route markings, dense place names too small to read. Muted sepia and faded indigo. NO modern text, NO watermark. The whole sheet fills the frame edge to edge.

items.name: map_ancient
items.prompt: A Ptolemaic world map drawn on parchment, circular known world, sea monsters at the edges, latitude lines in faded red.

items.name: map_voyage
items.prompt: An eighteenth-century nautical chart of the Atlantic, rhumb lines radiating from compass roses, faint red annotations along the routes.
